15 reactions | Sixteen Chinese nationals and four Zambians have been arrested in Zambia over alleged illegal gold mining and suspected pollution of Muneshi Stream in Mpika District, Muchinga Province.

The arrests were carried out by the Minerals Regulation Commission (MRC), working with the Zambia Environmental Management Agency (ZEMA) and state security agencies. Authorities accuse the 20 suspects of mining and processing gold without the required licences, using unidentified substances suspected of contaminating the waterway and obstructing its natural flow to facilitate their operations. 

The MRC says mining at the same site had been suspended about two months earlier, but operations allegedly continued, raising concerns over the stream’s impact on surrounding and downstream communities.
